name: ShaderCompileException
signature: public sealed class ShaderCompileException(string message) : Exception(message)

docs.summary: A shader failed to compile. The message lists every diagnostic as file:line: error: text.
The file the error is in, as its #line directive or include named it, when known.
1-based line of the error in [`File`](#api~Prowl.Graphite.ShaderDef.Compiler.ShaderCompileException~File), 0 when unknown.
1-based column of the error on [`Line`](#api~Prowl.Scribe.Line), 0 when only the line is known.
Length of the source text the error points at, 0 when unknown.
